In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the catalytic activity of the ordered mesoporous silicate–quater-nary ammonium composite material is due to its high surface area and pore volume and the presence of quaternary ammonium moieties in the framework.
the catalytic activities of these materials are dependent on the nature of the quaternary ammonium cations and the pore structure of the materials.

the catalytic performance of as-synthesized ordered porous silicate-quaternary ammonium composites is strongly dependent on the type and concentration of the quaternary ammonium salt used for the preparation, the nature of the organic template, and the reaction temperature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Knoevenagels reaction is catalyzed by the quaternary ammonium groups in as-synthesized ordered porous silicate materials, which are highly active in this reaction.
the as-synthesized silicate–quater- nary ammonium composite material is an excellent catalyst for the Knoevenagels reaction.
the catalysis is a result of the cooperative effect of the basicity of the silicate and the acidity of the quaternary ammonium groups.
